name: Super Free Play
description:
About This Game

Chow Down and POWER UP to save the Multi-World.

Orphans Jay and Dasha have a gift for turning snacks into superpowers. Together they're the Turbo Twins, defending the planet cluster from a rogues' gallery of bosses in need of battering.

Super Free Play is a 2D co-op retro-metroidvania platformer where you are what you eat, literally! Hot Chilis make you spew LAVA ROCKS! Gumballs turn you into a giant PINBALL! Chicken ala Garbage Can? You don’t want to know.

Jump, dash, and transform your way through every corner of the Multi-World - solo or side-by-side on the couch.

Created by Emmy Award-winning animator Matt Danner (Muppet Babies, Gravity Falls, Looney Tunes Show, Diary of a Wimpy Kid, Legend of the Three Caballeros).

Features

  • CHOW DOWN AND POWER UP!: Dozens of food-powered transformations. Every bite changes the fight.

  • BOSS BATTLES ON EVERY WORLD: Bash bosses across the world cluster from the bustling metropolis of City World to the dark depths of Jungle World and back!

  • COUCH CO-OP FOR TWO: Play as Jay or Dasha TOGETHER. Full local co-op from start to finish.

  • A WORLD BUILT FROM CLASSIC VIDEO GAMES AND CARTOONS: 2D animation mixed with 3D game models for a 2.5D gaming experience. A love letter to classic video games of the 80s and 90s AND their super cool game instruction booklet art.

  • BOSSES. BADDIES. BATTLES!: Uber Boss is sending everything he’s got to conquer the Multi-World but Jay and Dasha are up to the challenge!

Super Free Play draws inspiration from classic video games to make something NEW. The humour is modern, the action is fast, and the food powers are completely unhinged. It’s Teen Titans GO meets Mario Bros. with a dash of Adventure Time and a sprinkle of Sonic. Mix it all up and you get a cartoony platformer with the visual style of a classic instruction booklet.

Built by Spunge Games and Animasia. Wishlist now and join the community on Discord.
short_desc: Chow down and POWER UP! Super Free Play is a classic 2D co-op metroidvania platformer where super-powered Turbo Twins Jay and Dasha bounce on baddies, portal surf and fight bosses across the Multi-World. Fun for 1 or 2 players!
